description: Search the guide's chapters, margin notes and events for a Databricks question. Returns the best sections first, each with a snippet, its URL with the section anchor, and when the page last changed. Read one in full with get_chapter (pass the URL, or the slug and the anchor).

kind.description: Only chapters, margin notes (dated news with our position), feature pages or events

query.description: The question or topic in plain words, e.g. 'lakebase branch' or 'unity catalog row filters'

name: search_guide

build.description: The commit of the deploy that answered

index_built.description: When this deploy's index was built (ISO 8601)

next.description: When this is about a concept the guide explains interactively: the call for a step-by-step walkthrough

anchor.description: The section's anchor on the page

section.description: The section that matched; null for the introduction

updated.description: When the page last changed, YYYY-MM-DD (an event: its day)

ttlMs.description: How long this answer may be kept before asking again, in milliseconds

title: Search the guide
